title: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro Max 发布

paragraphs.en: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max feature the most advanced camera Apple has ever made and deliver massive leaps in battery life and performance. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max , delivering the most advanced pro camera system in an iPhone, and huge leaps in battery life and performance. The new 48MP Fusion Main camera, now with variable aperture, brings creative control that wasn’t possible before, and new Pro controls let users customize their experience in the Camera app. Both models feature a smaller and even more useful Dynamic Island, as well as A20 Pro and a next-generation vapor chamber that together deliver the highest sustained performance in iPhone history. iPhone 18 Pro Max also delivers the largest increase in battery life ever on iPhone, thanks to advancements in Apple silicon and a larger battery. 1 Featuring iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence 2 and Siri AI , 3 iPhone 18 Pro models bring powerful AI capabilities together with personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core. iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are available in four elegant finishes: black, silver, glacier, and an all-new burgundy. Pre-orders begin Saturday, September 12, with availability beginning Friday, September 18. “With iPhone 18 Pro, we’ve made advancements to the areas our users care about most: camera, performance, battery, and intelligence. And we didn’t just make incremental improvements in these areas — we took huge leaps forward to create the best Pro iPhone we’ve ever made,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “iPhone 18 Pro makes it easy for anyone to capture stunning photos and videos using variable aperture, while providing more versatility for creators and more control for pros. Paired with impactful upgrades to Photographic Styles and powerful video capabilities, iPhone 18 Pro unlocks entirely new ways for users to express themselves.” iPhone 18 Pro will be available in four elegant finishes: black, silver, glacier, and burgundy. An Advanced Camera System That Unlocks More Creativity Across Photo and Video The new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture is the most advanced camera Apple has ever made, bringing aperture control to iPhone for the first time along with even more creative control.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 配备了苹果迄今最先进的摄像头，并在电池续航和性能方面实现了巨大飞跃。 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日发布了 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max，带来了 iPhone 史上最先进的专业级摄像头系统，以及电池续航和性能的显著提升。 全新的 4800 万像素融合主摄像头现已支持可变光圈，实现了此前无法实现的创意控制；新的专业级控制功能则让用户能够在相机应用中自定义拍摄体验。 两款机型均配备了更小且更实用的动态岛、A20 Pro 芯片以及新一代蒸汽腔，共同实现了 iPhone 历史上最高的持续性能表现。得益于 Apple 芯片技术的进步和更大容量的电池，iPhone 18 Pro Max 的电池续航也实现了 iPhone 史上最大的提升。1 搭载 iOS 27 系统、Apple Intelligence 2 和 Siri AI 3 的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列机型，将强大的 AI 能力与个人上下文信息相结合，成为以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中心。iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 提供四种优雅配色：黑色、银色、冰川色以及全新的酒红色。 预购将于 9 月 12 日（星期六）开始，9 月 18 日（星期五）正式开售。“通过 iPhone 18 Pro，我们在用户最关心的领域——摄像头、性能、电池和智能功能——实现了重大突破。” “我们不仅在这些方面进行了渐进式改进，更实现了巨大的跨越，打造出了迄今为止最出色的专业级 iPhone，”苹果公司全球营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 表示，“iPhone 18 Pro 让任何人都能轻松通过可变光圈拍摄惊艳的照片和视频，同时为创作者提供了更多灵活性，为专业人士带来了更强的控制力。” “结合摄影风格的功能性升级和强大的视频能力，iPhone 18 Pro 为用户开辟了全新的自我表达方式。”iPhone 18 Pro 将提供四种优雅配色：黑色、银色、冰川色和酒红色。 一个释放更多创意可能性的先进摄像头系统（适用于照片和视频）：配备可变光圈的新款 4800 万像素融合主摄像头是苹果迄今最先进的摄像头，首次为 iPhone 带来了光圈控制功能，并提供了更丰富的创意操控选项。

paragraphs.en: Six laser-cut blades smoothly transition between different apertures, making it incredibly easy to capture the best shot by automatically adjusting for depth of field and lighting. Combined with a new sensor that improves image quality, the result is better low-light photography, crisper detail in the back of group photos, and more unique shots. Variable aperture also provides more control for creative pros by giving them the ability to manually adjust any of the four aperture settings in the Camera app, and an API is available to developers for even more control across the aperture range in their apps. The new 48MP Fusion Main camera uses six laser-cut blades controlled by a new rotor mechanism to smoothly transition between different apertures. With a new computational imaging pipeline, the Main camera produces sharper, more detailed shots, and upgraded Photographic Styles with new texture and grain controls let users further dial in their desired appearance and have more creative control over their photos. 4 Industry-leading video capabilities also become more versatile, with the ability to apply Cinematic effects after capture to videos shot at up to 60 fps. In Time-lapse mode, users can now record videos in 4K and Dolby Vision HDR. Audio Mix also has new algorithms that deliver higher-quality voices and can now isolate music. paragraphs.en: In darker environments, iPhone 18 Pro adjusts the aperture automatically to let in more light, resulting in stunning Night mode shots. iPhone 18 Pro introduces new texture and grain controls in Photographic Styles, so users can adjust color and skin qualities in unison for a more personalized look. Pro controls let users manually adjust settings, such as shutter speed, which can create artful motion blur in photos. A new computational imaging pipeline produces even more detailed shots from the Main camera. previous next Pro controls is a new customizable experience in the Camera app for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max that makes it easier than ever for users to access their most used settings and introduces new options for manual control. Users can now adjust settings such as lens aperture, shutter speed, and white balance, or use a histogram to check exposure levels throughout a scene. Pro controls offer broader creative range, with manual control over shutter speed, white balance, aperture, and the ability to use a histogram. Introducing Apple Reference Image Users can now prove the authenticity of a photo taken on iPhone 18 Pro models with Apple Reference Image, powered by the new sensor in the Main camera that can sign every pixel it sees. When a photo is taken in the new Reference mode, the camera captures signed sensor data that Private Cloud Compute develops into an unalterable reference image. 5 Reference images can be viewed in the Photos app alongside the main image, like a digital negative, to visually compare the two assets and determine if any edits were made. APIs are available in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 27 for third-party apps to enable viewing of these reference images. Apple Reference Image provides users with an unalterable reference photo, visually confirming what the sensor saw at the moment of capture. Image metadata and upcoming support for the SynthID standard can also help users identify images generated or edited with AI. 6 Together with Apple Reference Image, this set of features represents a multifaceted approach to image authenticity — vital for photojournalists, photographers, and everyday viewers. An Even More Useful Dynamic Island Using advanced display technology, the Dynamic Island is redesigned to create room for additional information.
paragraphs.zh: 在较暗的环境中，iPhone 18 Pro 会自动调整光圈以摄入更多光线，从而拍出令人惊艳的夜间模式照片。iPhone 18 Pro 在摄影风格中引入了新的纹理和颗粒控制功能，让用户可以同步调整色彩和肤质，打造更具个性化的视觉效果。 Pro 控制功能允许用户手动调整设置，例如快门速度，从而在照片中营造出富有艺术感的动态模糊效果。 全新的计算成像流程可让主摄像头拍出更加细腻的照片。Pro 控制是 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 相机应用中的一项全新可自定义体验，让用户比以往任何时候都更容易访问最常用的设置，并提供了新的手动控制选项。 用户现在可以调整镜头光圈、快门速度和白平衡等设置，或使用直方图检查整个场景的曝光水平。 Pro 控制提供了更广泛的创作空间，支持对快门速度、白平衡和光圈进行手动控制，并能使用直方图辅助拍摄。 Apple 参考图像功能现已推出。借助主摄像头中全新传感器的支持，用户现在可以通过 Apple 参考图像验证 iPhone 18 Pro 系列所拍照片的真实性，该传感器能够为它捕捉到的每个像素添加数字签名。 当以新的参考模式拍摄照片时，相机将捕获带有签名的传感器数据，并由“私密云计算”将其处理成无法篡改的参考图像。最多可保存 5 张参考图像，它们可以与主图一同在“照片”应用中查看，就像一张数字底片，便于对两者进行视觉对比，判断是否存在任何编辑操作。 iOS、iPadOS 和 macOS 27 提供了相应的 API，供第三方应用实现对这些参考图像的查看功能。 Apple 参考图像为用户提供了无法篡改的参考照片，能够直观地确认传感器在拍摄瞬间所捕捉到的原始画面。 图像元数据以及对 SynthID 标准的未来支持，也能帮助用户识别通过 AI 生成或编辑的图像。结合 Apple 参考图像，这一系列功能共同构成了一种多维度的图像真实性验证方案——这对摄影记者、专业摄影师和普通观众都至关重要。 更加实用的动态岛：借助先进的显示技术，动态岛经过重新设计，为更多信息的展示创造了空间。

A20 Pro: A Powerhouse for Pro Performance and AI Built using the latest 2-nanometer process technology, A20 Pro sets a new bar for mobile computing. Featuring 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro, the new 6-core CPU features integrated Neural Accelerators and is faster than the competition, while the new 7-core GPU design is up to 40 percent faster than A19 Pro — a significant upgrade for graphics rendering. A20 Pro also features a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, which accelerates on-device AI models and computational photography, and includes 32 total cores for double the AI processing power of A19 Pro. With huge upgrades across the entire chip, A20 Pro is a powerhouse for everything from more advanced on-device AI workloads to demanding games, and is designed to deliver exceptional performance for years to come. Featuring a new 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU, and Dual 16-core Neural Engine, A20 Pro is a powerhouse for pro performance. Both models feature N1, an Apple-designed wireless networking chip that enables Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. iPhone 18 Pro introduces C2, Apple’s next-generation cellular modem system, which brings AI-powered improvements to cellular quality and reliability. C2 delivers meaningfully faster uploads when compared to C1X while consuming 15 percent less energy, and now supports mmWave in the U.S. A New Thermal Management System for Maximum Performance A20 Pro introduces custom packaging inspired by M-series Apple silicon that places the silicon die side by side with the memory, removing the memory from the thermal path of the chip and allowing A20 Pro to attach directly to a next-generation vapor chamber. With new materials and three times more surface area than the previous generation on iPhone 17 Pro, the redesigned vapor chamber dramatically improves sustained performance and enables up to a 40 percent gain over the previous generation — the highest sustained performance yet. The next-generation vapor chamber dissipates even more heat and enables a massive leap in sustained performance on iPhone 18 Pro.

paragraphs.en: Incredible Battery Life iPhone 18 Pro models deliver a massive leap in battery life with new battery designs that leverage powerful silicon efficiencies. eSIM-only models deliver up to 36 hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro and up to 45 hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro Max. iPhone 18 Pro can also charge up to 50 percent in around 15 minutes, or wirelessly charge up to 50 percent in 30 minutes. 7 On iPhone 18 Pro Max, five minutes of wired charging provides around seven hours of video playback, and based on a new battery usage model that leverages real-world data, it provides up to 30 hours of usage on a full charge. 8 Both iPhone 18 Pro models feature updated battery designs that support faster wired charging and leverage powerful silicon efficiencies to deliver incredible battery life. Featuring iOS 27 with the Next Generation of Apple Intelligence and an All-New Siri iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max give users access to Siri AI, rolling out in beta with iOS 27. Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence that is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational. Both models bring powerful AI capabilities together with personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core. Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic. Siri mode in the Camera app allows users to get information and take action on what’s in front of them, and users can write with Siri by simply describing what they need. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. Users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing, Extend, and upgraded Clean Up. And now Image Playground offers photorealistic imagery. In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, and stay on top of updates. To protect users’ privacy, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy and security of iPhone into the cloud. Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across apps, and with Siri mode in the Camera app, they can get information on what’s in front of them.
paragraphs.zh: 令人惊叹的电池续航：iPhone 18 Pro 机型通过采用全新电池设计，利用强大的芯片能效技术，实现了电池续航的巨大飞跃。仅支持 eSIM 的机型在 iPhone 18 Pro 上可提供长达 36 小时的视频播放时间，在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上则可达 45 小时。iPhone 18 Pro 还可在约 15 分钟内充电至 50%，或在 30 分钟内无线充电至 50%。7 在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，只需 5 分钟有线充电即可支持约七小时的视频播放；根据利用真实世界数据构建的全新电池使用模型，满电状态下可提供长达 30 小时的使用时间。8 iPhone 18 Pro 两款机型均采用了更新后的电池设计，支持更快的有线充电，并借助强大的芯片能效技术，带来令人惊叹的电池续航。 搭载 iOS 27、新一代 Apple Intelligence 和全新 Siri：iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 为用户带来了 Siri AI，该功能将通过 iOS 27 以测试版形式推出。 Siri AI 是完全全新的 Siri 版本，由 Apple Intelligence 驱动，在个性化、功能性和对话能力方面实现了质的飞跃。 两款机型将强大的 AI 能力与个人上下文信息相结合，成为以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中枢。 Siri AI 能够利用对个人上下文的理解，帮助用户即时在消息、邮件、照片等应用中找到所需内容；还能通过屏幕感知功能，对屏幕上显示的内容执行相关操作，并回答几乎任何主题的问题。 相机应用中的 Siri 模式让用户能够获取有关眼前事物的信息并采取相应操作，用户只需描述需求，即可通过 Siri 进行书写。 此外，Apple Intelligence 还让各类应用变得更智能、更实用。 用户可以在拍摄照片后，利用空间重构图、扩展和升级后的清理功能来优化照片的构图。 现在，图像游乐场还能生成逼真的图像效果。 在 Safari 浏览器中，“通知我”功能可帮助用户监控网页变化，例如商品补货或价格下跌，从而随时掌握最新动态。 为保护用户隐私，Apple Intelligence 采用设备端处理和私有云计算技术，将 iPhone 的隐私与安全性延伸至云端。 Siri AI 能够利用对个人上下文的理解，帮助用户即时在不同应用中找到所需内容；通过相机应用中的 Siri 模式，用户还能获取有关眼前事物的信息。

sents.en: Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic.
sents.zh: Siri AI 能够利用对个人上下文的理解，帮助用户即时在消息、邮件、照片等应用中找到所需内容；还能通过屏幕感知功能，对屏幕上显示的内容执行相关操作，并回答几乎任何主题的问题。

sents.en: Siri mode in the Camera app allows users to get information and take action on what’s in front of them, and users can write with Siri by simply describing what they need.
sents.zh: 相机应用中的 Siri 模式让用户能够获取有关眼前事物的信息并采取相应操作，用户只需描述需求，即可通过 Siri 进行书写。

sents.en: Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful.
sents.zh: 此外，Apple Intelligence 还让各类应用变得更智能、更实用。

sents.en: Users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing, Extend, and upgraded Clean Up.
sents.zh: 用户可以在拍摄照片后，利用空间重构图、扩展和升级后的清理功能来优化照片的构图。

sents.en: And now Image Playground offers photorealistic imagery.
sents.zh: 现在，图像游乐场还能生成逼真的图像效果。

sents.en: In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, and stay on top of updates.
sents.zh: 在 Safari 浏览器中，“通知我”功能可帮助用户监控网页变化，例如商品补货或价格下跌，从而随时掌握最新动态。

sents.en: To protect users’ privacy, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy and security of iPhone into the cloud.
sents.zh: 为保护用户隐私，Apple Intelligence 采用设备端处理和私有云计算技术，将 iPhone 的隐私与安全性延伸至云端。

sents.en: Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across apps, and with Siri mode in the Camera app, they can get information on what’s in front of them.
sents.zh: Siri AI 能够利用对个人上下文的理解，帮助用户即时在不同应用中找到所需内容；通过相机应用中的 Siri 模式，用户还能获取有关眼前事物的信息。

paragraphs.en: iOS 27 delivers an expansive set of improvements that make iPhone more responsive, reliable, and easy to use, along with refinements to the software design and more ways to personalize the appearance of Liquid Glass. These models feature an even larger battery, taking advantage of the space formerly occupied by the physical SIM to provide two additional hours of video playback. Beautiful New Accessories iPhone 18 Pro models introduce a range of new Silicone Cases, TechWoven Cases, Crossbody Straps, and FineWoven Wallets — all designed to complement the four beautiful finishes. The Clear Case features an updated design and is now compatible with the Crossbody Strap and Wrist Strap. The new Wrist Strap introduces a convenient, hands-free way to carry iPhone, AirPods Pro 2, or AirPods Pro 3. Woven with 100 percent recycled polyester yarns and embedded with flexible magnets that keep it neatly fitted together, the Wrist Strap will be available in six colors: black, taupe, olive, crisp blue, magenta, and burgundy. iPhone 18 Pro in glacier is paired with the glacier Wrist Strap. A burgundy iPhone 18 Pro with coordinating case is paired with a magenta Crossbody Strap. iPhone 18 Pro in glacier is paired with the Clear Case. The new Wrist Strap introduces a beautiful hands-free way to carry iPhone. The Crossbody Strap can be paired with MagSafe cases in gorgeous new color combinations. New MagSafe accessories complement the elegant finishes of iPhone 18 Pro.

paragraphs.en: previous next iPhone 18 Pro and the Environment iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max were built with the environment in mind, and drive progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. Both models are made with 40 percent recycled content overall, 11 including 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery and 85 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure. They are manufactured with 50 percent renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and meet Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. Like all Apple products, their paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 12 and can be easily recycled at home. Pricing and Availability iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be available in 256GB, 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB storage capacities. Available in burgundy, glacier, silver, and black, iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 (U.S.) or $49.95 (U.S.) per month, and iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299 (U.S.) or $54.12 (U.S.) per month for 24 months. 13 Apple offers great ways to save and upgrade to the latest iPhone models. With Apple Trade In, customers trading in iPhone 13 or later can get $175 to $885 (U.S.) in credit instantly. 14 Apple also partners with select carriers to offer incredible deals, and customers can get up to $1,200 (U.S.) in credits when they trade in iPhone 14 or later — in any condition — to put toward iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max. Customers can take advantage of carrier deals by visiting the Apple Store online or an Apple Store location. For carrier deal eligibility requirements and more details, see apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/carrier-offers . To see what their device is worth and for trade-in terms and conditions, customers can visit apple.com/shop/trade-in . Apple Upgrade, a leasing program provided by Klarna and available in the U.S., gives eligible customers monthly payment options for iPhone 18 Pro, with 12- and 24-month leasing terms starting as low as $34.99 (U.S.) per month for 24 months. For more information, visit apple.com/shop/apple-upgrade . 15 Customers in more than 65 countries and regions, including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, Colombia, France, Germany, India, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Türkiye, the UAE, the UK, the U.S., and Vietnam, will be able to pre-order iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max beginning at 5 a.m. PT this Saturday, September 12, with availability beginning Friday, September 18.
paragraphs.zh: 上一页 下一页 iPhone 18 Pro 与环境 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的设计都充分考虑了环境因素，并推动了 Apple 宏伟计划的进展——即到 2030 年，在其整个业务足迹中实现碳中和。这两款机型整体采用 40% 的回收材料制成，其中电池使用 100% 回收钴，外壳使用 85% 回收铝。它们在整个供应链中均使用 50% 的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能）进行制造，并符合 Apple 在能源效率和安全化学配方方面的高标准。与所有 Apple 产品一样，其纸质包装完全由纤维制成，可在家中轻松回收。12 价格与供应 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 将提供 256GB、512GB、1TB 和 2TB 的存储容量。iPhone 18 Pro 有酒红色、冰川色、银色和黑色可选，起售价为 1,199 美元（美国）或每月 49.95 美元（美国）；iPhone 18 Pro Max 起售价为 1,299 美元（美国）或 24 个月分期每月 54.12 美元（美国）。13 Apple 提供了多种节省开支和升级到最新 iPhone 机型的好方法。通过 Apple Trade In 以旧换新计划，换入 iPhone 13 或更新机型的用户可立即获得 175 至 885 美元（美国）的抵用金。14 Apple 还与部分运营商合作提供超值优惠，用户若将任何状况的 iPhone 14 或更新机型以旧换新，最高可获 1,200 美元（美国）的抵用金，用于购买 iPhone 18 Pro 或 iPhone 18 Pro Max。用户可访问 Apple Store 网站或前往 Apple Store 门店，享受运营商提供的优惠。有关运营商优惠的资格要求和更多详情，请访问 apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/carrier-offers。要了解设备价值以及以旧换新的条款与条件，用户可访问 apple.com/shop/trade-in。Apple Upgrade 是由 Klarna 提供的一项租赁计划，目前在美国可用，符合条件的用户可为 iPhone 18 Pro 选择按月付款方案，24 个月租赁期的月付金额最低为 34.99 美元（美国）。如需了解更多信息，请访问 apple.com/shop/apple-upgrade。15 包括澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、中国、哥伦比亚、法国、德国、印度、日本、马来西亚、墨西哥、新加坡、韩国、土耳其、阿联酋、英国、美国和越南在内的 65 个以上国家/地区的用户，将于本周六（9 月 12 日）太平洋时间上午 5 点起预购 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max，产品将于 9 月 18 日（周五）开始发售。

paragraphs.en: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
paragraphs.zh: 苹果推出 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max

paragraphs.en: The new Pro lineup introduces variable aperture with the most advanced camera in an iPhone, incredible battery life, next‑level performance, and Siri AI, all powered by A20 Pro
paragraphs.zh: 全新的 Pro 系列推出了可变光圈，并搭载了 iPhone 中最先进的摄像头、令人惊叹的电池续航能力、更高层次的性能以及 Siri AI，所有这些都由 A20 Pro 芯片提供动力。

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max , delivering the most advanced pro camera system in an iPhone, and huge leaps in battery life and performance. The new 48MP Fusion Main camera, now with variable aperture, brings creative control that wasn’t possible before, and new Pro controls let users customize their experience in the Camera app. Both models feature a smaller and even more useful Dynamic Island, as well as A20 Pro and a next-generation vapor chamber that together deliver the highest sustained performance in iPhone history. iPhone 18 Pro Max also delivers the largest increase in battery life ever on iPhone, thanks to advancements in Apple silicon and a larger battery. 1 Featuring iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence 2 and Siri AI , 3 iPhone 18 Pro models bring powerful AI capabilities together with personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core.
paragraphs.zh: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日发布了 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max，带来了 iPhone 迄今最先进的专业级摄像头系统，以及电池续航能力和性能的巨大飞跃。 全新的 4800 万像素融合主摄像头现已支持可变光圈，实现了此前无法实现的创意控制；新的专业级控制功能则让用户能够在相机应用中自定义使用体验。 两款机型均配备了更小且更实用的动态岛、A20 Pro 芯片以及新一代蒸汽腔，共同实现了 iPhone 历史上最高的持续性能表现。得益于 Apple 芯片技术的进步和更大容量的电池，iPhone 18 Pro Max 的电池续航能力也创造了 iPhone 的历史最大增幅。1 搭载 iOS 27 系统、Apple Intelligence 2 和 Siri AI 的 3 iPhone 18 Pro 机型，将强大的人工智能能力与个人上下文信息相结合，成为以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中心。

paragraphs.en: An Advanced Camera System That Unlocks More Creativity Across Photo and Video
paragraphs.zh: 先进的相机系统，释放照片与视频创作中的更多可能性

paragraphs.en: The new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture is the most advanced camera Apple has ever made, bringing aperture control to iPhone for the first time along with even more creative control. Six laser-cut blades smoothly transition between different apertures, making it incredibly easy to capture the best shot by automatically adjusting for depth of field and lighting. Combined with a new sensor that improves image quality, the result is better low-light photography, crisper detail in the back of group photos, and more unique shots. Variable aperture also provides more control for creative pros by giving them the ability to manually adjust any of the four aperture settings in the Camera app, and an API is available to developers for even more control across the aperture range in their apps.
paragraphs.zh: 这款全新的 4800 万像素融合主摄像头采用可变光圈，是苹果迄今最先进的摄像头，首次为 iPhone 带来了光圈控制功能，并提供了更丰富的创意操控。 六片激光切割的镜片可在不同光圈之间平滑切换，通过自动调整景深和光线，让捕捉最佳照片变得极其轻松。 结合全新提升画质的传感器，最终实现了更出色的低光摄影效果、群像照片中背景细节更清晰，以及更多独特的拍摄成果。 可变光圈也为创意专业人士提供了更强的控制力：他们可以在相机应用中手动调整四种光圈设置中的任意一种；同时，开发者还可使用 API，在应用程序中实现更广泛的光圈范围控制。

paragraphs.en: Users can now prove the authenticity of a photo taken on iPhone 18 Pro models with Apple Reference Image, powered by the new sensor in the Main camera that can sign every pixel it sees. When a photo is taken in the new Reference mode, the camera captures signed sensor data that Private Cloud Compute develops into an unalterable reference image. 5 Reference images can be viewed in the Photos app alongside the main image, like a digital negative, to visually compare the two assets and determine if any edits were made. APIs are available in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 27 for third-party apps to enable viewing of these reference images.

paragraphs.en: A20 Pro: A Powerhouse for Pro Performance and AI
paragraphs.zh: A20 Pro：专业性能与人工智能的强大引擎

paragraphs.en: Built using the latest 2-nanometer process technology, A20 Pro sets a new bar for mobile computing. Featuring 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro, the new 6-core CPU features integrated Neural Accelerators and is faster than the competition, while the new 7-core GPU design is up to 40 percent faster than A19 Pro — a significant upgrade for graphics rendering. A20 Pro also features a new Dual 16-core Neural Engine, which accelerates on-device AI models and computational photography, and includes 32 total cores for double the AI processing power of A19 Pro. With huge upgrades across the entire chip, A20 Pro is a powerhouse for everything from more advanced on-device AI workloads to demanding games, and is designed to deliver exceptional performance for years to come.
paragraphs.zh: A20 Pro 采用最新的 2 纳米制程技术打造，为移动计算树立了新标杆。 与 A19 Pro 相比，其内存带宽提升了 50%；全新的 6 核 CPU 集成了神经加速单元，性能优于竞争对手；而全新的 7 核 GPU 设计速度最高可达 A19 Pro 的 40%——这对图形渲染而言是一次重大升级。 A20 Pro 还配备了全新的双 16 核神经网络引擎，可加速设备端 AI 模型和计算摄影，总共拥有 32 个核心，AI 处理能力是 A19 Pro 的两倍。 凭借芯片整体性能的巨大提升，A20 Pro 无论是运行更复杂的设备端 AI 任务，还是应对高要求的游戏，都能展现出强劲实力，并设计用于在未来多年持续提供卓越性能。

paragraphs.en: Both models feature N1, an Apple-designed wireless networking chip that enables Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. iPhone 18 Pro introduces C2, Apple’s next-generation cellular modem system, which brings AI-powered improvements to cellular quality and reliability. C2 delivers meaningfully faster uploads when compared to C1X while consuming 15 percent less energy, and now supports mmWave in the U.S.

paragraphs.en: A New Thermal Management System for Maximum Performance
paragraphs.zh: 实现极致性能的全新技术散热系统

paragraphs.en: A20 Pro introduces custom packaging inspired by M-series Apple silicon that places the silicon die side by side with the memory, removing the memory from the thermal path of the chip and allowing A20 Pro to attach directly to a next-generation vapor chamber. With new materials and three times more surface area than the previous generation on iPhone 17 Pro, the redesigned vapor chamber dramatically improves sustained performance and enables up to a 40 percent gain over the previous generation — the highest sustained performance yet.
paragraphs.zh: A20 Pro 采用了受 M 系列 Apple 芯片启发的定制包装方案，将硅晶元与内存并排布置，使内存脱离芯片的热传导路径，从而让 A20 Pro 能够直接连接到下一代蒸汽腔。 借助全新材料以及比 iPhone 17 Pro 上一代产品大三倍的表面积，重新设计的蒸汽腔显著提升了持续性能，使其较上一代产品最高提升 40%——实现了迄今为止最高的持续性能。

paragraphs.en: iPhone 18 Pro models deliver a massive leap in battery life with new battery designs that leverage powerful silicon efficiencies. eSIM-only models deliver up to 36 hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro and up to 45 hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro Max. iPhone 18 Pro can also charge up to 50 percent in around 15 minutes, or wirelessly charge up to 50 percent in 30 minutes. 7 On iPhone 18 Pro Max, five minutes of wired charging provides around seven hours of video playback, and based on a new battery usage model that leverages real-world data, it provides up to 30 hours of usage on a full charge. 8
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 机型通过采用全新电池设计，并充分利用强大的芯片能效技术，实现了电池续航能力的巨大飞跃。仅支持 eSIM 的 iPhone 18 Pro 机型可提供长达 36 小时的视频播放时间，而 iPhone 18 Pro Max 机型则可达 45 小时。iPhone 18 Pro 还支持约 15 分钟充电至 50%，或在 30 分钟内无线充电至 50%。7 在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，只需五分钟有线充电即可支持约七小时的视频播放；根据一种基于真实世界数据的新电池使用模型，其满电状态下可提供长达 30 小时的使用时间。8

paragraphs.en: Featuring iOS 27 with the Next Generation of Apple Intelligence and an All-New Siri
paragraphs.zh: 搭载 iOS 27、新一代 Apple Intelligence 以及全新 Siri

paragraphs.en: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max give users access to Siri AI, rolling out in beta with iOS 27. Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence that is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational. Both models bring powerful AI capabilities together with personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 让用户能够使用 Siri AI，该功能将通过 iOS 27 以测试版形式推出。 Siri AI 是完全全新的 Siri 版本，由 Apple Intelligence 提供支持，在个性化、功能性和对话能力方面都实现了显著提升。 这两款机型将强大的 AI 能力与个人上下文信息相结合，成为一个以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中心。

sents.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 让用户能够使用 Siri AI，该功能将通过 iOS 27 以测试版形式推出。

sents.en: Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence that is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational.
sents.zh: Siri AI 是完全全新的 Siri 版本，由 Apple Intelligence 提供支持，在个性化、功能性和对话能力方面都实现了显著提升。

sents.en: Both models bring powerful AI capabilities together with personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core.
sents.zh: 这两款机型将强大的 AI 能力与个人上下文信息相结合，成为一个以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中心。

paragraphs.en: Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic. Siri mode in the Camera app allows users to get information and take action on what’s in front of them, and users can write with Siri by simply describing what they need. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. Users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing, Extend, and upgraded Clean Up. And now Image Playground offers photorealistic imagery. In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, and stay on top of updates. To protect users’ privacy, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy and security of iPhone into the cloud.
paragraphs.zh: Siri 人工智能可以利用对个人背景的理解，帮助用户即时在消息、电子邮件、照片等中查找所需内容；还能通过屏幕感知功能对用户屏幕上的内容执行操作，并回答几乎任何主题的问题。 相机应用中的 Siri 模式让用户能够获取有关眼前事物的信息并采取行动，用户只需描述需求，即可通过 Siri 进行书写。 此外，Apple Intelligence 还让应用程序变得更智能、更实用。 用户可以在拍摄照片后，利用空间重构图、扩展和升级后的清理功能来优化照片的构图。 现在，图像游乐场还能生成逼真的图像。 在 Safari 中，“通知我”功能可帮助用户监控网页变化，例如商品补货或降价，从而随时掌握最新动态。 为保护用户隐私，Apple Intelligence 采用设备端处理和私有云计算，将 iPhone 的隐私与安全性延伸至云端。

paragraphs.en: iOS 27 delivers an expansive set of improvements that make iPhone more responsive, reliable, and easy to use, along with refinements to the software design and more ways to personalize the appearance of Liquid Glass. Additionally, powerful and simple tools , based on expert guidance, give parents more flexible ways to manage what their kids can see, who they can talk to, and when they have access. iOS 27 also introduces iPhone Handoff, which allows users with supported carriers to easily switch back and forth between two iPhone models with the same phone number. 9
paragraphs.zh: iOS 27 带来了一系列广泛的改进，使 iPhone 响应更迅速、更可靠且更易于使用，同时还优化了软件设计，并提供了更多个性化 Liquid Glass 外观的方式。 此外，基于专家指导的实用而简单的工具为家长提供了更灵活的方式来管理孩子能看到的内容、可以交谈的对象以及使用设备的时间。iOS 27 还引入了 iPhone 接力功能，支持该功能的用户可以在两个 iPhone 机型之间轻松切换，同时保留相同的电话号码。9

sents.zh: 此外，基于专家指导的实用而简单的工具为家长提供了更灵活的方式来管理孩子能看到的内容、可以交谈的对象以及使用设备的时间。iOS 27 还引入了 iPhone 接力功能，支持该功能的用户可以在两个 iPhone 机型之间轻松切换，同时保留相同的电话号码。9

paragraphs.en: eSIM: A Flexible, Convenient, and Secure Connection
paragraphs.zh: eSIM：灵活、便捷且安全的连接

paragraphs.en: eSIM offers greater flexibility, better security, seamless connectivity compared to traditional physical SIM cards, and more battery life on eSIM-only models. 10 An industry standard, eSIM is supported by over 500 carriers worldwide, including AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, and more. eSIM-only models of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be available in Bahrain, Canada, Guam, Japan, Kuwait, Mexico, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the U.S., and the U.S. Virgin Islands. These models feature an even larger battery, taking advantage of the space formerly occupied by the physical SIM to provide two additional hours of video playback.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统实体 SIM 卡相比，eSIM 提供了更高的灵活性、更强的安全性和无缝连接，并且仅使用 eSIM 的机型电池续航时间更长。10 eSIM 是一项行业标准，全球超过 500 家运营商均支持该技术，包括 AT&T、T-Mobile、Verizon 等。iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的纯 eSIM 机型将在巴林、加拿大、关岛、日本、科威特、墨西哥、阿曼、卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、美国和美属维尔京群岛上市销售。 这些机型配备了容量更大的电池，利用原本实体 SIM 卡所占用的空间，额外提供了两小时的视频播放时间。

paragraphs.en: iPhone 18 Pro models introduce a range of new Silicone Cases, TechWoven Cases, Crossbody Straps, and FineWoven Wallets — all designed to complement the four beautiful finishes. The Clear Case features an updated design and is now compatible with the Crossbody Strap and Wrist Strap. The new Wrist Strap introduces a convenient, hands-free way to carry iPhone, AirPods Pro 2, or AirPods Pro 3. Woven with 100 percent recycled polyester yarns and embedded with flexible magnets that keep it neatly fitted together, the Wrist Strap will be available in six colors: black, taupe, olive, crisp blue, magenta, and burgundy.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 机型推出了一系列全新硅胶保护壳、TechWoven 编织保护壳、斜挎带和 FineWoven 编织钱包——所有产品均旨在与四种精美外观相得益彰。 透明保护壳采用了更新的设计，现已支持搭配斜挎带和腕带使用。 新款腕带提供了一种便捷的双手自由携带方式，可用于携带 iPhone、AirPods Pro 2 或 AirPods Pro 3。 腕带采用 100% 再生涤纶纱线编织而成，并嵌入了可使其紧密贴合的柔性磁铁，将推出六种颜色：黑色、灰褐色、橄榄绿、纯净蓝、品红和酒红色。

paragraphs.en: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max were built with the environment in mind, and drive progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. Both models are made with 40 percent recycled content overall, 11 including 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery and 85 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure. They are manufactured with 50 percent renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and meet Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. Like all Apple products, their paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 12 and can be easily recycled at home.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的设计充分考虑了环境因素，推动了苹果实现“到 2030 年在其整个业务足迹中实现碳中和”这一宏伟计划的进程。 这两款机型整体采用 40% 的回收材料制成，其中电池使用 100% 回收钴，外壳则使用 85% 回收铝。 它们在整个供应链中均使用 50% 的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能）进行制造，并符合苹果在能源效率和安全化学配方方面的高标准。 与所有苹果产品一样，它们的纸质包装完全由纤维制成，并且可以在家中轻松回收。

paragraphs.en: Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
